claim: The new guard bails out whenever `server.hot` is falsy, not just when `server` itself is undefined, so it also short-circuits the existing `server.ws.send` fallback path for servers that expose `ws` but not `hot`, changing behavior for those existing callers instead of only handling the bundledDev `server === undefined` case (and silently dropping the full-reload notification that fallback was written to send).

The new guard bails out on `!server?.hot`, but the function's own fallback path a few lines later still uses `server.ws.send` for servers that expose `ws` but not `hot`, so those servers now silently skip the full-reload logic entirely instead of reaching the `server.ws.send` branch.
